metadata.intro: Welcome to the Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics gateway. This roadmap connects the macroscopic laws of heat and entropy to their microscopic statistical foundations and ultimate cosmological implications.

pillars.title: 1. The Laws of Thermodynamics & The Arrow of Time
pillars.narrative: Explores the macro-scale axioms of heat, the irreversible nature of entropy, and the philosophical implications of the universe's highly ordered initial state.

pillars.title: 2. Statistical Mechanics & Kinetic Theory
pillars.narrative: Bridges the gap between microscopic particle dynamics and macroscopic thermodynamic observables using statistical distributions.

pillars.title: 3. Gravitational Thermodynamics & Black Holes
pillars.narrative: Examines the intersection of thermodynamics and General Relativity, where event horizons act as thermal boundaries and gravity dictates entropy.

pillars.title: 4. Cosmological Thermodynamics & The Ultimate Fate
pillars.narrative: Applies thermodynamic principles to the expansion of the 4D manifold, culminating in the final equilibrium states of the cosmos.
